title: 连接 StarReel
description: 在 StarReel → 设置 → API Key 创建一把 produce 权限的密钥（srk_live_ 开头，只展示一次）粘贴到这里。密钥只保存在本机，用于调用你自己账户下的短剧产线，生成类操作会扣你账户的点数。
description_en: Create an API key with the produce scope in StarReel → Settings → API Keys (starts with srk_live_, shown only once) and paste it here. The key stays on this device and calls the pipeline under your own account; generation steps spend your account points.

fields.label: API Key
